draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Following up on my welcome note last week — I know new tools can slip down the list in a busy week.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating that first project is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Priya
